title: backlog.json defaults lane_module to kblane and land_push to the kb's kbgit.py sync, so a host project must override both (second-project run)
goal: A project with no backlog.json, or one naming neither key, gets lane_module empty and a land_push that names no kb script, and the kb's backlog.json names its own values; found while fixing BG-cmvwrpbr, whose goal names seven other keys

run: import subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d]); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',d,'config'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; bad=[l for l in o.splitlines() if l.startswith(('lane_module = ','land_push = ')) and 'kblane' in l or 'kbgit.py' in l]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

gates.question: What do lane_module and land_push default to in a project whose backlog.json names neither?
options: lane_module empty (no code lane); land_push empty, so land stops before the push and names the key the project must set
lane_module empty; land_push defaults to git push of HEAD to the main branch
gates.recommendation: lane_module empty (no code lane); land_push empty, so land stops before the push and names the key the project must set
gates.answer: lane_module empty (no code lane); land_push empty, so land stops before the push and names the key the project must set
